title: S73 — Data: case-twin probe corpus for S70 (manifest + hash, regenerable)
desc: GOAL: build a case-twin probe corpus (200 items: mixed-case words where every character is recoverable but case is ambiguous — x-height twins o/O, c/C, s/S; plus stitch-style strikethrough variants) with committed manifest + hash + plain-reader baseline rows + a small montage. WHY: S70 (case instrument) needs dev/held-out material that isolates case decisions; canonical suites carry only 9 case misses. STEPS: build with committed generator helpers; do NOT alter canonical recipes (official suite hash must not move); heavy images are generated, not committed — commit manifest + hash + regen command + montage. EVIDENCE: reports/case-corpus/<date>/ + PUSHES row + formalcode line. BOUNDARIES: fresh seeds only. Boundaries: no edits to shipping paths unless the task says so; no tuning on canonical seeds 1/2/3/4/53 (evaluation only); honest numbers — no 98/95 claims; captchaproject(s) off-limits.
